name: Docket Wire
tagline: Where East Africa's deals stand, and who still has to say yes
description: Live dockets on the deals and disputes that reach East Africa's regulators and courts: every approval, challenge and date on the record, with its source.
lede: Docket Wire keeps a live file on each deal and dispute in Kenya and the region: the regulators and courts it has to pass, every step on the record with its source, and the dates coming up.
